original.statement: The storage version of the ec2nodeclasses.karpenter.k8s.aws CRD changes from v1beta1 to v1; existing objects remain stored as v1beta1 until rewritten, so a storage version migration and a status.storedVersions update are needed before a later release removes v1beta1.

decision.reason: The change text comes from a computed diff between the v0.37.8 [ev-8998581760b8] and v1.0.0 [ev-451bd6a12e72] ec2nodeclasses CRD files. It says the storage version moves from v1beta1 to v1, that existing objects stay stored as v1beta1 until rewritten, and that a storage version migration plus a status.storedVersions update must run. That supports a migration-family subject with the type migration-required, which is the only change type the migration family uses. The name "storage-version-migration" comes from the text's own words. The CRD name as component is the most precise identity and keeps this step separate from the matching nodepools and nodeclaims migrations. Confidence is low because the evidence excerpts are empty, so the decision rests on the computed-diff text and not on readable excerpt content.
